newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bridge says lawsuit unfounded.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bridge says lawsuit unfounded.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp said on Friday that allegations contained in a class action shareholder complaint served on December 9 were "entirely unfounded and frivolous."
Dominion Bridge said no relevant information was withheld from shareholders and that the company had engaged in fully compliant disclosure practices.

"Dominion Bridge intends to vigorously contest these frivolous charges and will pursue all available remedies against those responsible for this willful and malicious attack on the company, its shareholders and management," Michel Marengere, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"We have always been compliant and fully disclosed necessary or material information," he said.
Marengere said Dominion Bridge had undergone rapid and substantial growth and its prospects remained very strong.
